title: fix(auth): phone + password sign-in on a two-factor account asks for the code, as the email path does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBMj1VWhvpEoRtmBUqz3VYa2)_

Fixes #32107

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：开了两步验证的账号用「手机号 + 密码」登录控制台时，现在和邮箱登录一样进入验证码页，输入有效验证码即可登录；不再误报「手机号或密码错误」。
- 为什么改：服务器其实已接受密码并要求第二步验证，但客户端只认「有 token 才算成功」，把两步验证挑战当成了密码错误，这类用户用手机号完全登录不进去。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@object-ui/auth` 一个包的登录客户端与登录表单，无服务器、spec 改动；普通手机号账号与错误密码的行为不变（有测试守着）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`（共享的两步验证读取函数 `readTwoFactorChallenge`）、`ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`（手机号登录把挑战交给验证码页）、`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`（手机号分支与邮箱分支走同一个验证码步骤）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/twoFactorSignIn-29105.test.tsx packages/auth/src/__tests__/twoFactorSignIn-client-29105.test.ts`，预期 19 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One reader of the two-factor challenge.** The email path's inline parse of better-auth's `{ twoFactorRedirect, twoFactorMethods }` answer is lifted into `readTwoFactorChallenge` inside `createAuthClient`, which also drops the `set-auth-token` that names the session better-auth's two-factor hook just deleted. `signIn` and `signInWithPhonePassword` both call it; neither carries its own copy.
- **`AuthClient.signInWithPhonePassword`** answers `SignInResult` (the type `signIn` answers): a session, or `{ twoFactor: { methods } }`. It used to throw "Invalid phone number or password." for any answer without a token, which is exactly what better-auth answers on `/sign-in/phone-number` for a two-factor account.
- **`AuthProvider` / `AuthContextValue.signInWithPhonePassword`** sets `twoFactorChallenge` on a challenge and resolves `{ twoFactorRequired }` (was `void`), mirroring `signIn`.
- **`LoginForm`**: the phone-shaped identifier branch and the email branch share one `twoFactorRequired` check, so a phone sign-in reaches the same code step and the host hears `onSuccess` only after the code is verified.
- **Root changeset** `.changeset/32107-phone-password-two-factor.md`, `@object-ui/auth` patch, with the two declaration lines.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` measured: the published `AuthClient` and `AuthContextValue` types are reachable from the package entry, and both methods' answers gain a member (the challenge arm; `{ twoFactorRequired }` in place of `void`). The one in-tree reader that dereferenced `result.user` / `result.session` directly (`createAuthClient.test.ts`, phone sign-in case) now reads them with optional chaining, which is what `type-check` asked for. No caller outside `ui/packages/auth` names `signInWithPhonePassword` (tree grep at this head).

## Tests

- New top-level describe in the client harness `twoFactorSignIn-client-29105.test.ts`: phone + password on a two-factor account answers the challenge and keeps no token even when the answer carries `set-auth-token`; CONTROL a plain phone account still gets a session; CONTROL a wrong password still rejects with the server's `code` and `status`.
- New top-level describe in the form harness `twoFactorSignIn-29105.test.tsx` (real `AuthProvider` + `LoginForm`): the phone password leads to the code prompt with no error, nobody signed in and no `onSuccess` until the code is verified, then signs in; CONTROL a plain phone account signs straight in; CONTROL a wrong phone password still shows "Invalid phone number or password." and no code step.
- `@object-ui/auth`: 45 files / 432 tests pass (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/auth/`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth run type-check` exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

1. Client: `const twoFactor = readTwoFactorChallenge(payload);` in `signInWithPhonePassword` replaced by a constant `null` (the old behaviour: fall through to the token check and throw). Result: "answers the same challenge as the email path and keeps no token, even the one the answer names" goes red, 1 failed / 18 passed; restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. Provider: the phone sign-in's challenge branch replaced by an immediate `{ twoFactorRequired: false }`. Result: "asks for the code after the phone password, as on the email path, then signs the user in" goes red, 1 failed / 9 passed; restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The tests import `createAuthClient` and `AuthProvider` by relative path (source, not `dist`), so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `signInWithPhoneOtp` is out of this card's scope and unchanged.
- **Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over every touched file: hits only in regions this PR does not edit, all in `AuthProvider.tsx` (session position, objectui#5424) and `types.ts` (objectui#5424 retired field; passkeys follow-up, objectui#2514; the objectstack#25083 feature flag). None governs the edited lines.
- No package README or `content/docs/frontend/` page documents `signInWithPhonePassword` or the two-factor step today, so there is no doc to update.
- Serial: PR #32050 (login pages, `signInRefusalMessages.ts`) does not touch any file in this diff; `main` merged at this head.

## Verification

<details><summary>Browser check on a fresh showcase boot (card's reproduction), shots in the project folder 32107-shots/</summary>

- Backend: `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` with `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true` and `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`; Console: `ui/apps/console` Vite dev server over this branch's source, proxied to that backend.
- `phone.demo@example.com` enrolled in TOTP through `/two-factor/enable` + `/two-factor/verify-totp`; then `POST /sign-in/phone-number` answered 200 `{"twoFactorRedirect":true,"twoFactorMethods":["totp"]}` (the card's step 4).
- In the browser: "Email or phone number" = `+8613800138000`, password `showcase123`, Sign In. The card showed "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app." with no alert (`2-code-prompt.png`). A current TOTP code: `POST /two-factor/verify-totp` 200, the app opened at the showcase home, and `get-session` named `phone.demo@example.com` (`3-signed-in.png`).
- CONTROL: the same number with a wrong password shows "Invalid phone number or password" and no code step (`4-wrong-password-control.png`).
</details>
